notes.title: October 20th Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[DEMO Version] Update, Version Number: 0.1.5

[olist]
[*] Fixed typos
[*] Adjusted the effect of the status "Fear"
[*] Fixed an issue with the damage calculation of the skill "Swift Strike"
[*] Fixed an error in the game guide's description of the "Status" section (Note 1)
[*] Added new explanations for "Leader Skills and Encounters" to the game guide (Note 1)
[/olist]


If you encounter any issues in the game, feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/bc2tgVJmfQ]official Discord channel[/url] to provide feedback to the developer. Thank you to all players!

notes.title: September 23 Update Announcement
notes.notes:
[DEMO Version] Update, Version: 0.1.3

Fixed an issue where GP could be reset in the Anomaly Zone.
Fixed an issue where Kaori wouldn't accept cooked food in the camp.
Updated the description text for the item "Return Scroll."
Modified the dialogue text for camp NPCs.

If you encounter any issues in the game, feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/bc2tgVJmfQ]official Discord channel[/url] to provide feedback to the developer. Thank you to all players!

notes.title: Update Announcement - September 22
notes.notes:
[DEMO Version] Update, Version: 0.1.2

1.Fixed a bug where the teleport point in Chapter 4 sent players to the wrong location.
2.Adjusted some enemy stats.
3.Added hint guides for certain stages (puzzle/exploration) in Difficulty (1).
4.Adjusted the dialogue of the NPC in the Strange Wind quest.

If you encounter any issues in the game, feel free to join the [url=https://discord.gg/bc2tgVJmfQ]official Discord channel[/url] to provide feedback to the developer. Thank you to all players!
